statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. The Sunday NQ gap remains materially unrepaired into early Asia, with regional equities weak, oil above $107 and Treasury yields elevated; direct evidence of repeated failed NQ retracements remains incomplete.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail remains minimally elevated because the technology-sensitive gap has persisted alongside aligned Asia, oil and rates stress, while incomplete direct pullback evidence limits further escalation.
headline: Persistent NQ gap and Asia weakness keep Tail minimally elevated
body: Reuters reported broad Asian equity losses as oil rose about 3% and U.S. yields stayed high. Fresh supplementary Finviz context from 23:41 UTC still showed NQ near -1.0% versus ES near -0.5%, supporting gap persistence without proving repeated failed retracements.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours, 21 assessments were green at Tail 19, the 22:00 UTC reopening moved to WATCH at Tail 24, 23:00 UTC rose to Tail 27, and 00:00 UTC eased to Tail 25 while the Sunday gap remained largely intact. Stress was extreme from 03:00 UTC onward.
outlookSummary: Tail remains minimally elevated while the Sunday gap persists alongside weak Asian equities, high yields and elevated oil. The path can normalize quickly if Asia produces meaningful retracements and two-way NQ trade; renewed downside efficiency or fresh energy escalation would keep Tail elevated.

forecast.analysis: Fresh Reuters Asia reporting shows broad regional losses while oil rises and yields stay high; supplementary Finviz context from 23:41 UTC still had NQ near -1.0% versus ES near -0.5%. The reopening gap remains persistent, but repeated failed NQ retracements are not directly verified.

forecast.analysis: Tail remains minimally elevated conditionally if Tokyo and Seoul weakness continues to reinforce the unrepaired NQ gap. A meaningful NQ rebound or broader two-way trade would weaken the persistence case.
WATCH becomes the conditional base if Asian trading broadens into two-way price discovery without fresh NQ downside extension. Renewed lows with shallow rebounds would invalidate the easing.
Tail eases conditionally if the initial reopening shock is absorbed and the overnight range expands both ways. Continued holding near the lows with rising oil would keep risk higher.
Lower WATCH is conditional on visible retracement capacity by late Asia. Cross-asset stress can stay extreme even if NQ itself stops tracing a one-way path.

Risk remains near the WATCH floor conditionally into the Europe pre-open. Stable NQ structure would support normalization, while another energy or geopolitical impulse could re-open the downside path.
The Europe cash open is a conditional transmission checkpoint. Tail rises if European technology weakness, firm oil and an unrepaired NQ gap align with shallow rebounds.

Early Europe remains a conditional WATCH zone because broader participation can either confirm the overnight selloff or force a deeper retracement. Relative NQ performance versus ES is the key discriminator.
Tail eases conditionally if European trade becomes balanced and NQ no longer holds near overnight extremes. A renewed session-low test would keep the risk path elevated.
Mid-Europe risk remains conditional on whether the Sunday gap is being repaired before U.S. liquidity takes over. Softer oil or stronger technology futures would reduce path risk.
U.S. premarket liquidity begins to matter more in this hour. Tail rises conditionally if NQ relative weakness persists while yields and oil remain firm.
The late premarket is a conditional checkpoint for whether the overnight gap survives broader U.S. participation. Holding near lows with rising volatility would strengthen the one-way-path case.
The U.S. cash open falls inside this hour. Tail reaches the top of WATCH conditionally because opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would be the clearest near-term escalation signal.
The first full cash hour remains WATCH conditionally. Repeated extension after failed rebounds would lift Tail; a strong retracement into the overnight gap would lower it.
Tail eases conditionally if the opening move becomes two-sided and NQ stops holding near session extremes. Oil and yields remain confirmation or conflict inputs.
Mid-session path risk continues to normalize conditionally if retracements remain available. A fresh technology-led downside leg would challenge that assumption.
Tail stays near the lower WATCH boundary conditionally as afternoon liquidity develops. The distinction remains choppy digestion versus renewed efficient trend extension.
A modest WATCH buffer returns conditionally ahead of the late session because unresolved geopolitical and rates stress can re-amplify an otherwise balanced equity tape.
Power-hour risk lifts Tail conditionally. Persistent NQ downside into the final cash hour, especially with firm oil and volatility, would strengthen the one-way-path case.
Around the U.S. cash close, Tail remains WATCH conditionally while late positioning is assessed. A close near session lows after failed rebounds would keep risk elevated into Globex.
Post-cash Tail eases conditionally if closing pressure does not extend into evening futures. Two-way trade would argue for continued normalization despite extreme macro Stress.
Late-evening Tail sits at the WATCH threshold conditionally. Fresh geopolitical headlines or another oil acceleration could quickly reopen the overnight danger window.
Tail remains WATCH conditionally into the next Asia handoff if the market has not fully repaired the Sunday gap. Stable cross-assets and visible retracement capacity would favor lower path risk.
The next Asian handoff remains a conditional WATCH checkpoint. With Empire State due later Tuesday, current path quality and cross-asset stability matter more than the future release itself.

forecastDetail.comment: Asia weakness and the unrepaired NQ gap keep Tail minimally elevated, while direct evidence of repeated failed retracements remains incomplete.
Minimal elevation persists conditionally if Asian weakness reinforces the gap; meaningful NQ retracement would weaken the case.
WATCH is conditional on two-way Asian trade without fresh lows; shallow rebounds and renewed extension would invalidate the easing.
Risk improves conditionally if the overnight range broadens and NQ stops holding near the lows.
Lower WATCH is conditional on visible late-Asia retracement capacity despite extreme macro and energy Stress.
The Europe pre-open stays near the WATCH floor unless a fresh geopolitical or energy impulse restores directional pressure.
